activated_reserves.reason: All eight published zone observations have no observable area under the quality mask; primary retained in coverage audit.
activated_reserves.evidence: reports/history/processing-plan.md; coordinator confirmed unusable acquisition before this activation.

activated_reserves.reason: Both earlier chronological candidates have zero observable area in all eight zones each. Jan 8 retains its first recoverable I/O failure and must be retried before later reserves.
All three earlier chronological candidates have zero observable area in all eight zones each. Jan 8 completed its recoverable retry before this activation; no earlier candidate was skipped.

Both ports have zero reviewable marine area in the first raw quality review of the cloudy Oct 2 primary. STC's small automatically clear fragment is terrestrial/hazy and was independently abstained. Activate only the next chronological candidate within the same Oct 1–9 calibration slot; retain all primary failures.

Both ports have an entirely zero automatic observability mask and all eight primary observations are unusable. Four visually discernible berth hulls are retained only as raw quality-disagreement evidence; no reviewed operational area can be exported. Activate the first chronological reserve within the same Oct 17–25 slot, without consulting its predictions, scores or vessel counts.

All eight primary observations have zero observable pixels. Activate the first chronological reserve in the same Nov1-Nov9 slot before opening its imagery or proposals. Original primary abstentions remain recorded.
All eight observations unusable; each full observable mask has zero positive pixels. Saturated raw previews do not support a vessel presence or absence claim.
